Title: Azure Cosmos DB: General availability in the North Central region

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB now supports provisioning Cosmos DB accounts in the North Central US region. This brings the total region count to 18, including: Central US, East US, South Central US, West US, North Europe, West Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, both regions in Japan and Australia, all three regions in India, and both preview regions in Germany. The India regions are available to volume licensing customers and partners with a local enrollment in India.

Try out Azure Cosmos DB today by signing up for a Microsoft Azure free account, and then create a Azure Cosmos DB database account by using the Azure portal.

For more information about Azure Cosmos DB, visit the Azure Cosmos DB page.
